libraries.name: Colour-tracking camera
libraries.author: Bench Workshop
libraries.description: A small camera that finds the biggest patch of one colour (red, green, blue, yellow...) in what it sees and tells a board where it is over I2C, like the Pixy or HuskyLens cameras robots use. A screen on its back shows what it sees. Includes BlobCam.h for sketches.

libraries.name: LCD 16x2 (I2C)
libraries.author: Bench Workshop
libraries.description: The classic blue 16x2 character LCD (HD44780) with an I2C backpack (PCF8574): text on 2 lines over just 2 wires. Includes LiquidCrystal_I2C.h for sketches; real firmware using LiquidCrystal_I2C works too.

libraries.name: LCD 16x2 green (parallel, LiquidCrystal)
libraries.author: Bench Workshop
libraries.description: A 16x2 character LCD (HD44780) with green text, wired the classic parallel way: RS, E and four data pins, as in Arduino's LiquidCrystal examples. Includes LiquidCrystal.h for sketches. Needs its contrast pin (V0) set, like the real one.

libraries.name: LED matrix 8x8 (MAX7219)
libraries.author: Bench Workshop
libraries.description: The common red 8x8 LED matrix module with a MAX7219 driver: 64 LEDs from 3 pins (DIN, CS, CLK). Includes LedControl.h for sketches.
